about: The Wikimedia Commons videos fetched for the body-movement measurement (#373). `file` is the local name under the app-data dir's body/src (the download's own, percent-encoded); `work` names the #373 intermediates under body/work (pose streams decoded from 640x360 transcodes, beat grids, provenance notes), which the backfill (#510) copies or points at; `fixtures` are the committed excerpts. Labels say where they came from.
